text: 进入四季度，电力市场淡季不淡。在迎峰度夏结束、高温负荷逐步消退的背景下，广东、江苏等地月度交易电价不降反升，南方区域现货价格亦持续走强。此外，10月13日，江苏电力交易中心印发《2027年江苏电力零售市场交易工作指引》，推动批零价格全面传导。行业专家表示，本轮电价上涨是供需两端多重因素叠加的结果，属于市场运行中的合理波动；江苏新版规则为电价向用户侧传导提供了机制样本。多名券商公用事业研究员判断，2026年或是国内电价底部，拐点正在显现。（上海证券报）
text_en: Entering the fourth quarter, the power market is not sluggish in the off-season. Against the backdrop of the end of peak summer demand and the gradual fading of high-temperature loads, monthly trading electricity prices in Guangdong, Jiangsu and other places have risen rather than fallen, and spot prices in the southern region have also continued to strengthen. In addition, on October 13, the Jiangsu Power Exchange Center issued the "2027 Jiangsu Power Retail Market Trading Work Guidelines" to promote the full transmission of wholesale and retail prices. Industry experts said this round of electricity price increases is the result of multiple factors on both the supply and demand sides and is a reasonable fluctuation in market operation; Jiangsu's new rules provide a mechanism example for transmitting electricity prices to the user side. Several brokerage utility researchers judge that 2026 may be the bottom of domestic electricity prices, and a turning point is emerging. (Shanghai Securities News)
